collection.title: Ford Ranger 1999 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Ranger 1999 to 2010 model requires a 18" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper.
